mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at 70 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. Tonight, expect an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, please remember that all city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Additionally, Thursday trash and recycling collection will be pushed to Friday, November 27.

For your calendar, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch more music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company or check out Yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday.

Regarding local safety, on November 2, officers responded to a report of a domestic disturbance in the 100 block of West End Circle which resulted in the arrest of a 48-year-old Verona man for battery and disorderly conduct.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Crazy for Cookie Dough. They are currently open, so feel free to stop by anytime before they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
